 HOW TO USE

How to Use Discount Codes on ERIGO's Website

  • Add Items to Your Cart: Browse ERIGO's website and select the items you want to purchase. Click "Add to Cart" for each item.
  • View Your Cart: Once you've finished shopping, click on the shopping cart icon usually located in the top right corner of the website.
  • Proceed to Checkout: Review the items in your cart to make sure everything is correct. Then, click "Proceed to Checkout" or a similar button.
  • Enter Shipping Information: Fill in your shipping address and contact details.
  • Enter Discount Code: Look for a field labeled "Discount Code" or "Promo Code" on the checkout page. Enter your code exactly as it appears (case-sensitive).
  • Apply Discount: Click the "Apply" or "Use Code" button next to the discount code field. The discount should be reflected in your order total.
  • Review and Complete Your Order: Double-check your order details, including the discounted price. If everything looks good, click "Place Order" or a similar button to finalize your purchase.
